title: Technical Manager
description:
ELLKAY started out providing connectivity solutions to laboratories and within a few years, grew to also provide data management solutions to ambulatory organizations. ELLKAY is now a trusted data management partner in five healthcare segments. ELLKAY’s solutions continue to serve laboratories and ambulatory practices and have expanded to empower hospitals and health systems, healthcare IT vendors, ambulatory practices, health plans, and other healthcare organizations with cutting\-edge technologies and solutions that drive their growth and interoperability strategies.
   

  

 Today, ELLKAY remains true to our core values, building strong partner relationships and offering unparalleled service and support while providing innovative, scalable solutions to the challenges our customers face in today’s data\-rich world.
   

  

 ELLKAY's experience, customer\-focused approach, and reputation for innovation, speed, and accuracy differentiate ELLKAY as a premier partner for your interoperability needs and data management strategy.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Technical Manager will be responsible for overseeing the performance of the assigned team, ensuring the timely and high\-quality delivery of projects. The role involves identifying and resolving issues that impact team performance, implementing corrective actions, and supporting team members and providing technical solution support. The Technical Manager will also oversee hiring, onboarding, and training of new employees.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Oversee team performance, addressing issues to ensure quality and timely project delivery.
* Evaluate project outcomes and implement corrective actions for continuous improvement.
* Continuously evaluate processes and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Manage resource allocation, ensuring alignment with project needs and timelines.
* Attending client meetings to provide technical support and coordinate project requirements with the team.
* Interview and onboard new team members, providing necessary training and support.
* Foster team growth through mentorship and feedback.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, computer science, or a related field (master’s degree preferred).
* 2\+ years of experience in a team leadership or management role; 3\+ years of experience in healthcare data analytics, migration, or ETL projects.
* Experience in Epic systems migration or strong knowledge of Epic system implementation, including timelines, workflows, and data formats.
* Understanding of Epic data structures and data extraction or conversion processes.
* Familiarity with data governance, security, and compliance in healthcare environments, ensuring adherence to HIPAA and other regulations.
* Proven ability to evaluate and enhance team performance, implement corrective actions, and improve efficiency.
* Experience in project evaluation, monitoring, and resource management, ensuring successful completion of multiple concurrent projects.
* Strong communication skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills to address challenges and optimize team performance.


**Additional Information**
 ELLKAY is committed to fostering a collaborative and high\-performance work environment that supports innovation, teamwork, and professional growth. Most roles are designed to operate from our office locations to encourage effective collaboration and engagement across teams.
   

  

 Any alternative work arrangements may be considered at the company’s discretion based on role requirements and business needs.
   

  

 For more information about our company, please visit www.ELLKAY.com .

title: Internal Project Coordinator
description:
This role exists to protect one person's time and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. You'll be the right hand to the Operations Head — managing his calendar, capturing what happens in meetings, and making sure every internal and marketing project moves forward without him having to chase it.
 



 This is not just scheduling and note\-taking. You are the person who knows the status of everything, reminds the right people at the right time, and keeps the operation organized while leadership focuses on growth. This is a high\-trust, high\-visibility role — you'll see how a 90\-person company runs from the inside.
 



  





*This role is for someone who enjoys:* 



* Holding the full picture of what's happening across a busy leader's world
* Turning conversations into clear, owned, time\-bound follow\-ups
* Following up firmly and politely until things actually get done
* Being trusted with confidential, high\-stakes information



  





 If you're someone who's naturally organized, doesn't let things slip, and wants a front\-row seat to how a growing company operates, this role will suit you well.
 



  





**What you'll really be doing** 




  





**1\. Calendar \& Inbox Management** 



* Own and organize the Operations Head's calendar end to end — schedule, reschedule, resolve conflicts, protect focus time
* Coordinate across time zones, primarily India and US
* Manage email triage: flag what needs attention, draft routine replies, keep the inbox under control



  





**2\. Meeting Support** 



* Attend designated internal, marketing, and leadership meetings to capture minutes, decisions, and action items
* Convert discussions into clear, assigned, time\-bound follow\-ups
* Distribute notes promptly and make sure owners know what they committed to



  





**3\. Internal \& Marketing Project Coordination** 



* Keep all internal and marketing projects organized and current in the project management system
* Track status, deadlines, and blockers across active work
* Follow up with team members on tasks assigned by the Operations Head — proactively, before things slip
* Surface what's overdue or at risk before it becomes a problem



  





**4\. Follow\-Up \& Accountability** 



* Maintain a live view of every open commitment across the team
* Remind people on pending items and close the loop
* Be the system that ensures "I asked someone to do this" actually gets done



  





**Who will thrive in this role** 



* You hold many threads at once without dropping any of them
* You follow up firmly and politely — you don't let things go quiet
* You can work independently from week one with minimal supervision
* You're discreet and trustworthy with confidential business information
* You communicate clearly and confidently with US\-based leadership and partners



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 




  





**Experience** 



* 4–5 years minimum as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or Project Coordinator — experience within an IT services company is a must



  





**Must Have Skills**

description:
**ABOUT US:**




  





 Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private\-sector satellite mass\-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high\-volume manufacturing.
 



  





 As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end\-to\-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost\-effective, high\-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.
 



  





  





**JOB SUMMARY:**




  





 As a Senior Project Coordinator within our Project Management Office (PMO), you will act as the operational backbone for active satellite manufacturing and mission delivery cycles. Partnering directly with Project Managers and engineering leads, you will drive execution discipline, eliminate cross\-functional bottlenecks, and ensure mission milestones transition seamlessly from CAD models to cleanroom assembly and launch manifests.
 



  





 Your core operational mandate is predictability: maintaining airtight milestone tracking, accelerating internal procurement loops, and ensuring documentation meets rigorous aerospace standards. In this role, your success will be measured by on\-time milestone delivery rates (OTD), schedule variance reduction, and data accuracy across our PMO toolstack.
 



  





  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**




  




* **Drive Schedule \& Milestone Integrity:** 
 Partner with Project Managers to maintain comprehensive work\-breakdown structures (WBS), track critical\-path deliverables, and flag schedule variances before they impact integration timelines.
* **Streamline Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 
 Serve as the day\-to\-day liaison between systems engineering, cleanroom manufacturing, quality assurance, procurement, and external launch partners.
* **Lead PMO Governance \& Meeting Cadence:** 
 Own sprint ceremonies, technical review agendas, and cross\-team standups; capture high\-signal minutes of meeting (MoM) and aggressively drive action\-item closure.
* **Maintain Technical Documentation \& Metrics:** 
 Centralize technical baseline documents, flight readiness paperwork, and engineering change requests (ECRs) while building real\-time status dashboards for executive review.
* **Proactive Risk \& Blocker Resolution:** 
 Surface manufacturing delays, component lead\-time anomalies, and integration risks early; run root\-cause follow\-ups to implement mitigation strategies.
* **Coordinate Technical Procurement \& Logistics:** 
 Expedite technical purchase requisitions (PR/PO workflows) for mission\-critical parts and coordinate precision logistics for aerospace\-grade hardware and testing campaigns.



  





  





**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR ?**




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Aerospace, Mechanical, Electronics, or similar) or Business Administration/Operations Management.
* 1–2 years of hands\-on project coordination or PMO experience in a fast\-paced, engineering\- or manufacturing\-driven environment.
* Working proficiency with industry\-standard project tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Microsoft Project, Asana, or ClickUp).
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, with a track record of managing multiple competing deadlines without dropping operational details.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, comfortable interfacing with senior engineering specialists and external vendors.



  





  





**NICE\-TO\-HAVES:**




  




* Prior exposure to the Space, Aerospace, Defense, or Precision Hardware Manufacturing sectors.
* Foundational understanding of satellite subsystems, avionics, payload integration, or cleanroom manufacturing workflows.
* Familiarity with hardware product lifecycle stages (PDR, CDR, TRR, and flight integration).



  





  





**WHY JOIN US ?**




  




* **Front\-Row Seat to the NewSpace Revolution:** 
 Work on physical flight hardware destined for orbit from India’s first commercial satellite mass\-production hub.
* **Accelerated Career Trajectory:** 
 Receive hands\-on mentorship from veteran aerospace program managers, developing deep domain expertise across space mission lifecycles.
* **High\-Impact, Zero\-Red\-Tape Culture:** 
 Experience the speed of a high\-growth tech disruptor paired with the manufacturing infrastructure of an aerospace leader.
* **Collaborative Ecosystem:** 
 Join an ambitious, multidisciplinary team of space enthusiasts, engineers, and builders dedicated to making space accessible globally.
